verses.1: And Solomon was the king over all the kings from the river of the land of Philistia, all up to the borders of Egypt. He brought gifts to Solomon, and he served Solomon throughout his entire life.
verses.2: And it happened that on one day, there were thirty cords of wheat and sixty cords of barley.
verses.3: Twelve bullocks for the sacrifice, and twenty bullocks for the sin offering. And a hundred sheep, along with goats, lambs, and other animals like those mentioned in the scriptures.
verses.4: For he went along all the banks of the river, up to Azah. He passed through all the kings who lived along the river. And he was happy in every place he traveled.
verses.5: And Judah and Israel would be secure under one man’s rule, from Dan to Beer Sheva, throughout all the days of Solomon.
verses.6: And Solomon had forty thousand horses for his chariots, and twenty thousand horsemen.
verses.7: And all these people who are standing here will be present at King Solomon’s court. No one new will be allowed to enter the king’s court.
verses.8: And the shorsim and the teben for the horses and for the treasures will be brought to the place where a man will be placed, according to his judgment.
verses.9: And God gave Solomon great wisdom and many other gifts. His heart was also very kind, just like the heart of a shepherd who cares for his sheep.
verses.10: Shlomo’s wisdom exceeded the wisdom of all the ancient men. His wisdom also surpassed that of all the wise men from Egypt.
verses.11: And he was feared by all people, from the smallest to the greatest. All nations knew his name.
verses.12: And three thousand men spoke. Their number was five hundred and ten.
verses.13: And he spoke about the trees that grew in Lebanon, and about the trees that grew along the walls. He also spoke about the animals, the birds, and the fish.
verses.14: And they came from all nations to hear Solomon’s wisdom. All the kings of the earth heard his wisdom.
verses.15: And Hiran, the king of Zor, sent his servants to Shlomo. He heard that Shlomo was being made king after his father’s death. Hiran loved David all those days long.
verses.16: And Solomon sent Hilkiah there, saying:
verses.17: You know that David, my father, could not build a house for the LORD his God because of the wars that raged around him until the LORD brought them under His control.
verses.18: And now, let Jehovah my God protect me from all around. There is no evil or harm anywhere.
verses.19: And I say to the daughters of the house, “For the sake of the LORD your God, as the LORD said to my father David: ‘Your son who will be placed under your charge will build this house for me.’”
verses.20: And now, I command that they be made my servants. My servants shall serve your servants, and you shall give them their wages as you say. You know that no one can skillfully carve wood like you do.
verses.21: And when Hiram heard Solomon’s words, he was very happy. He said, “Blessed be Jehovah today, for he has given wisdom to David, son of Jesse, for this great people.”
verses.22: And Heirham sent Hiram to Solomon, saying, “I have heard what you sent me. I will do all that you desire. I will make everything from cedar trees and cypress trees.”
verses.23: My servants will come down from the heavens. I will speak to them through the waters, until they reach the place where you will be sent. Then they will be destroyed there. And you will carry out what I desire, so that I may give bread to my house.
verses.24: And He gave Shlomo cedar trees and cypress trees, everything he desired.
verses.25: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand units of fine linen for his house. He also gave him twenty units of tin. Solomon gave Hiram these gifts every year.
verses.26: And Jehovah gave wisdom to Solomon, just as He had spoken to him. Then Solomon became friends with Hiram and with Solomon himself. They made a covenant between them.
verses.27: King Solomon gathered all the men from Israel. The total number of men who gathered was thirty thousand.
verses.28: And he sent them to Banon. There were twelve thousand men in total. They would stay in Banon for two months. And Adoniram was in charge of them.
verses.29: And Solomon had seventy thousand porters and two hundred thousand soldiers in the army.
verses.30: Only those who are employed in the work of making three thousand and three hundred roods of cloth for the people who do this work.
verses.31: And the king ordered that large stones be brought in order to build the house. It was necessary to use precious stones for constructing the house.
verses.32: And the sons of Shlomo and the sons of Hurim prepared for the construction. They prepared the trees and stones for building the house.
